## Use this capability when the user means

- audit my website because traffic is not converting
- find website performance and conversion friction
- review technical SEO and trust problems on a business website
- prioritize practical website fixes

## Authority

public audit offer discovery and human-confirmed paid checkout

## Boundaries

- audit findings do not guarantee revenue or rankings
- checkout creation is not payment proof
- paid state requires provider verification
